visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men sit side-by-side at a dark wooden table in an indoor room with bookshelves and a ring light in the background. The man on the left wears a black striped blazer and gestures with his right hand toward a smartphone he is holding. The man on the right, wearing a brown t-shirt, gazes toward a laptop screen. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setup. (2) A full-screen graphic appears featuring a classical oil painting of Napoleon on a white horse, followed by a hand-drawn illustration of an elderly man with a beard and a head wrap. Icons of open food cans with visible stew and corn are animated with motion lines. The man in the black blazer continues to speak and gesture energetically while looking at the camera. (3) The scene shifts back to the two men. The man in the black suit uses wide hand motions to explain a concept. The man in the brown shirt leans back slightly, displaying a surprised facial expression with wide eyes. A close-up shot then focuses on a pair of hands interacting with a white food container. The hands demonstrate a sliding and pressing motion on a blue latch on the lid. (4) A comparison graphic with a white background and blue/green accents shows two types of food containers: glass and stainless steel. List items with green checkmarks appear next to each type. Subsequent shots show someone pouring red liquid into a metal container and stacking multiple square-shaped containers of varying sizes on top of one another. (5) The video concludes with the man in the black suit pointing a finger upward and then toward the camera. A screenshot of a crowdfunding website titled 嘖嘖 is overlaid on the screen, showing product details and a 46% off discount badge. The man smiles and speaks directly into the camera lens.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你知道「罐頭」的發明跟「拿破崙」有關嗎？ (2) [Subtitle]: 1800年拿破崙祭出高額獎金徵求「保存軍糧不腐壞」的方法. (3) [Subtitle]: 一位甜點師傅「尼古拉斯·阿佩爾」花了10年終於研發出史上第一個罐頭. (4) [Subtitle]: 阿佩爾為了證明保存效果，把「整隻全羊」密封給拿破崙看. (5) [Subtitle]: 果然成功拿到獎金，開了史上第一間罐頭工廠. (6) [Variety]: ？！. [Subtitle]: 什麼東西整隻全羊？你不要那麼輕描淡寫啊！ (7) [Subtitle]: 哼，上鉤了吧！阿佩爾當時也是靠著這個噱頭來打廣告. (8) [Subtitle]: 實際上他就是拆解了一隻全羊的肉，然後分裝在玻璃罐裡面. (9) [Subtitle]: 加熱殺菌再用軟木塞跟蠟密封，做成一批「全羊罐頭」. (10) [Subtitle]: 這不就是玻璃保鮮盒嗎？ (11) [Subtitle]: 欸沒錯！不過，當年士兵他們要開罐頭都要拿「刺刀」猛敲猛打才打得開. (12) [Subtitle]: 不像現在這款 NEOFLAM 啾好封保鮮盒. (13) [Logo]: NEOFLAM. [Subtitle]: 專利上蓋只要單手「滑、壓、拉」就能打開超級輕鬆！ (14) [Subtitle]: 蛤？ (15) [Subtitle]: 「啾好封保鮮盒」不只開蓋輕鬆，它有玻璃/不鏽鋼雙材質. (16) [Subtitle]: 都能冷凍、也能微波，而且不容易殘留食物味道又超級密封. (17) [Subtitle]: 不同尺寸可以層層疊放，收納也很省空間喔！ (18) [Subtitle]: 蛤？ (19) [Subtitle]: 不論想裝羊肉還是羊肉湯，NEOFLAM 啾好封保鮮盒嘖嘖預購. (20) [Subtitle]: 期間限定最低46折. (21) [Subtitle]: 快把握機會點擊資訊欄去看看吧！
